text:
Tess A: Heads-up for people in Berlin next week 1: looking for quick dinner spots near our Friedrichshain office 37d
Marco G: If you want cheap + fast: Mustafa's Kebab near Warschauer Str. is a classic, usually under 10 min service. late-night lifesaver.
Priya S: For something sit-down but cozy, try Bratwursthaus Vetter on Boxhagener Strasse. takes ~20 min but worth it for schnitzel.
Liam O: If you're vegetarian, Tommi's Vegan Df6ner (corner of Revaler) is surprisingly good and fast.
Adri: Quick non-Berlin recs: BRU (Brussels) tip 1: the waffle kiosk after security is great if you have <40 min. choose butter + sugar for speed.
Tess A: @Marco @Priya good notes. Marco, is Mustafa ok for small groups? queue gets long on Fri nights.
Marco G: Queue spikes 7-9pm. if >4 people, split and reconvene at the canal benches. also cash + card both accepted.
Priya S: Also FYI: Bratwursthaus can do takeaway if you call ahead, they wrap it quick.
Liam O: Chennai/MAA travel tip: the airport masala dosa stall in Domestic Departures is legit and under 15 min prep. for anyone flying through India.
Adri: For short EU layovers: look for places with visible fryers/grills 1 faster than made-to-order stuff. and always preorder where apps exist (saves 5-10min).
TacoBot: :taco: Poll created: "Post-work dinner vibe: kebab / sit-down German / vegan spot / wings & beers" (react to vote)
Tess A: Also planning a little "late-night snacks" sign-up 1 Friday after sync, bring something shareable. no nuts pls.
Marco G: i'll bring mini döner sliders if people want to try a few.
Priya S: i'll bring a small box of pretzel bites from Bratwursthaus (nut-free).
Liam O: i'll put a note in the travel recs doc about queue times and the best gates for BRU waffle kiosk.
Adri: if anyone's flying MAA next month DM me, i've got a shortlist of cheap dosas around the city.
Tess A: perfect, thanks! i'll pin the poll and put the snack sign-up sheet in #lunch-plans.
